plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that an inventor named Townsend Brown was born in 1905 in Zanesville, Ohio. According to Michels, old newspaper clippings show Brown building a wireless telegraph, a device that sends messages without wires, at around age 12. He tells it as an early sign of the gifted inventor Brown would become.
